growthSection.title: Turn booking demand into better-paid, route-friendly days.
growthSection.subtitle: MagicHango is positioned for trainers who already get demand, but lose margin through scattered appointments, manual scheduling, and clients choosing times that break the route.

metrics.label: A simple target: recover one extra useful session per week.
Guide clients toward edge slots that reduce tiny agenda gaps.
Show the right price for travel, route fit, and schedule friction.

booking.title: Lead with client self-booking
booking.body: The acquisition hook is not another calendar. It is a booking flow that helps clients choose times the trainer can actually profit from.

route.title: Make route quality visible
route.body: Route-friendly slots get a small incentive, while awkward slots can stay standard, cost more, or disappear from the client view.

pricing.title: Connect pricing to operations
pricing.body: Travel fees, smart discounts, and surcharges turn the trainer's real constraints into a simple client-facing price.
